description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'LearningShell' that provides a tabbed interface to switch between Video, Whiteboard, and Chat screens in the learning platform. It manages tab states and builds the main scaffold layout with app bar and tab views.

classes.name: LearningShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget serving as the main interface for switching between video, whiteboard, and chat screens.

classes.name: _LearningShellState
classes.description: State class managing tab controller and building the layout with tab bar and tab views.

methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the LearningShell widget.

methods.name: _LearningShellState.dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the tab controller when widget is removed.

methods.description: Builds the tab bar widget with icons and labels.
